chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from al-Isfahani, from al-Minqari, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath the judge, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Jafar ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them, saying:

When any of you wishes that he does not ask Allah Most High for anything except that He grants it, then let him despair of receiving from all people, and let him have no hope except from Allah, Mighty and Majestic. For when Allah Most High knows that from his heart, He will not be asked for anything except that He grants it.

He said: 'Take account of yourselves before you are called to account, for the stations of the Day of Resurrection are fifty stations, each station is a stay of a thousand years.' Then he recited this verse: 'On a day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.'

key_terms.الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, the Day of Judgment
key_terms.رَجَاءٌ: hope, expectation — here meaning exclusive reliance on Allah
key_terms.مَوْقِفًا: station, place of standing on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about how to have every supplication answered by Allah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq teaches that whoever desires all their supplications to be answered must place their hope exclusively in Allah and despair of receiving from people. When Allah perceives this sincerity in one's heart, He grants every request. The Imam then exhorts self-accounting before the Day of Judgment, noting it has fifty stations each lasting a thousand years, citing Quran 70:4 about the day of fifty thousand years' duration.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from his father who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from al-Ishfahani, from al-Minqari, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath al-Qadhi, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, say:

"When anyone of you wishes that Allah grants him whatever he asks for, then he should despair of receiving anything from men; and he should pin hope on none but Allah, Most High. When Allah knows that from his heart, He grants him all his wishes."

He said: "Take account of yourselves (by introspection) before you are called upon to do so, for the place on the Day of Resurrection has fifty stations, each one has a stay of one thousand years." Then he recited the verse: ’... one day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.’ [70:4].
